note: Both sets cover all 15 rows of Table 7-1 plus the rated rotor speed and rated mechanical power, with identical bindings, units and conditions. Both also contain the same two misread values (-82.60E+6 for the 18.0 m/s row and -113.40E+6 for the 23.0 m/s row) stated alongside the correct values, and both repeat six rows as duplicates. The only differences are cosmetic wording of the entity/attribute labels (e.g. 'rotor | rated mechanical power' vs 'mechanical power | rated power'), so the sets are equally good.
remarks: Both extractions appear to come from the same upstream pipeline: each emits the correct and an incorrect variant of the 18.0 m/s (-83.94E+6 vs -82.60E+6) and 23.0 m/s (-114.30E+6 vs -113.40E+6) rows, and each duplicates six rows (11.4, 12.0, 17.0, 21.0, 22.0, 24.0 m/s). The table is fully legible in the image; the text layer garbles the equations (7-16a/7-16b), but neither set extracted them. Neither set captures the qualitative finding that pitch sensitivity varies nearly linearly with blade-pitch angle (Eq. 7-16) or the frozen-wake linearization assumption.
